excavation_context.character_description: An adult male grad student working as a museum preparator, short dark hair, tanned skin. Wears signature thin-rimmed BLACK RECTANGULAR lens glasses, a light blue tee shirt worn UNDER a white lab coat, blue jean slacks and black dress shoes.
excavation_context.stage: Chiseling Claystone Matrix from an Ornithomimid Specimen

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_1, wearing his black rectangular lens glasses, hunches over a dust-shielded laboratory table, meticulously utilizing a tiny dental pick to separate fragile layers of light grey claystone matrix. His work isolates the delicate, toothless beak and cranial structure of an Archaeornithomimus skull. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
